files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- Support for Nextcloud 33 and 34

### Changed

- Updated `@nextcloud/files` to v4.0.0 — migrated file actions to the new context-based API (`ActionContext`, `INode`)

### Removed

- Support for Nextcloud 32
